description: T-054: the Newhaven skiff (a Text exit, `borrow skiff`), then GREET and ASK of the boatman on the Silvermere pier (ask_monster_a_question). Not recorded: written for the differential harness from the room-walk route and the stock data; the levers and the statue button of the crypt need the tomb door bashed open (random), so the crypt walkthrough is run by hand (T-057). T-084: the walk no longer goes down to the Arena (1:2150) for the closed door, `open`, `exits` and `search` steps (m1/room-walk has them): the Arena is type 2 with mongroup 6, a lone player in it gets a monster on 90% of the generation cycles, and run 38823959731's kobold thief (montype 6) came from there. Every room left on the walk has mongroup 0 (the Pier 2): monsters keep to rooms of their own group and a mongroup-0 room generates only montype-0 monsters (the stock ones are stationary, a dummy or an NPC), apart from Angels and Quest monsters.

mask.why: every direction name carries a random capital letter and a backspace, rewritten each slow cycle: `nJ\borth`
HP/mana in the prompt depend on earlier fights and regen
monsters and players that happen to be around

steps.note: Text exit: the skiff to Silvermere
the Pier (1813): the boatman is its specific monster
GREET: the talk block (5) links to 6, shown with the name
ASK: no line matches: `boatman has nothing to tell you!`
